description: This file contains the implementation of the ReactAgentScreen widget, a Flutter UI screen for the ReAct Agent app. It manages user input, displays a list of steps, and provides UI elements for starting, clearing, and displaying the state of the agent.

classes.name: ReactAgentScreen
classes.description: Main Flutter widget representing the React Agent screen, managing state and UI layout.

classes.name: _ReactAgentScreenState
classes.description: Private state class for ReactAgentScreen, handling controllers, user input, UI updates, and interaction logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers and sets up listeners when the widget is inserted into the widget tree.

methods.name: _onChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the ReactAgentController's state to update UI and manage scrolling.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up controllers and listeners to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method that constructs the entire UI of the ReactAgentScreen.

methods.name: _buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header section of the UI, including title, description, user input field, and action buttons.

methods.name: _buildSteps
methods.description: Builds the list view showing the sequence of steps of the agent.

methods.name: _buildEmpty
methods.description: Builds the UI shown when there are no steps, prompting user interaction.
